description.value:
Break Effect score +3. An attacking Ultimate forces targets to make a Constitution save; failure gives +1 allied hit damage taken for 2 turns, or +2 if your total Break Effect bonus is at least +3.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching abundance Path required.
